document:0:88:0.text: Use <style="highlight">fire brew</style> as the base brew, then add 10ml of <style="highlight">egg white</style>, 15ml of <style="highlight">guava juice</style>, and 3ml of <style="highlight">honey syrup</style> to create this unique cocktail. A friendly reminder from Bols: the order of the ingredients is very important.
document:0:88:0.source_cn: 以<style="highlight">焰酒</style>作为基酒，再加上十毫升<style="highlight">蛋清</style>，十五毫升<style="highlight">番石榴汁</style>，最后佐以三毫升<style="highlight">蜂蜜浆</style>，就能调出一支风味独特的酒。波尔斯友情提醒，调酒顺序很重要。
